people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of Yahweh their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
translations.bsb: and even Judah did not keep the commandments of the LORD their God, but lived according to the customs Israel had introduced.
translations.kjv: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
translations.asv: Also Judah kept not the commandments of Jehovah their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
